normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool **Pool heating is available Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Short Walk or Bike Ride to Seaside - Gulf Views from 4th Floor Tower- 6 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Tucked within beautiful Seagrove Beach, White Azaela offers an idyllic 30A getaway. This 4-level home easily accommodates up to 18 guests with 6 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms. Enjoy lazy, sunny days stretched out by the private pool or relaxing on the beach—only a 4-minute walk!A professionally decorated interior with dark wood floors and crisp shiplap walls awaits inside this elegant home. Drop beach totes and toys in the mudroom, with a washer and dryer for refreshing towels and swimsuits. The great room brims with natural light and is spacious enough for the whole group to enjoy time together. Chefs and entertainers will love the gorgeous kitchen’s Thermador appliances and free-standing ice maker, all centrally located. The dining table has space for 8, with 5 additional seats at the breakfast bar. In the living area, 2 slip-covered couches and 2 armchairs invite guests to relax or watch TV. French doors lead to a furnished deck and fenced-in backyard with a crystal-clear private pool. Savor tart lemonade on the soft patio seating as the water feature provides a soothing soundtrack. When the sunshine beckons, there’s seating around the pool and a sun shelf—perfect for keeping cool or introducing little ones to the water. At bedtime, guests will find a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom on this level.The second level hosts 4 guest bedrooms—2 of the bedrooms have queen beds and 2 have king beds. There’s also a sleeping nook with a twin-over-twin bunk bed and a TV.The third floor is ideal for young adults or families with a kitchenette, picnic-style dining table, sitting area, TV, and a substantial guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and 2 twin beds.Up the spiral staircase to the fourth level, discover a deck with a high-top table for 4 and enchanting views of the turquoise Gulf.Experience a delightful Seagrove Beach escape at White Azaela. Exploring is easy with 6 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, as well as on-site parking. Scenic 395 Beach Access is a short 4-minute walk down Azalea Street and East County Highway 30A. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds and 2 Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateFOURTH FLOOR:- Deck with Gulf views*Parties, weddings, or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing. Fees apply. Contact us for additional details.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Seagrove Beach "White Azaela" 77 Azalea St Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 6 Beds 9 Sleeps 18 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private pool **Pool heating is available Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day - 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Short Walk or Bike Ride to Seaside - Gulf Views from 4th Floor Tower - 6 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Tucked within beautiful Seagrove Beach, White Azaela offers an idyllic 30A getaway. This 4-level home easily accommodates up to 18 guests with 6 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms. Enjoy lazy, sunny days stretched out by the private pool or relaxing on the beach—only a 4-minute walk! A professionally decorated interior with dark wood floors and crisp shiplap walls awaits inside this elegant home. Drop beach totes and toys in the mudroom, with a washer and dryer for refreshing towels and swimsuits. The great room brims with natural light and is spacious enough for the whole group to enjoy time together. Chefs and entertainers will love the gorgeous kitchen’s Thermador appliances and free-standing ice maker, all centrally located. The dining table has space for 8, with 5 additional seats at the breakfast bar. In the living area, 2 slip-covered couches and 2 armchairs invite guests to relax or watch TV. French doors lead to a furnished deck and fenced-in backyard with a crystal-clear private pool. Savor tart lemonade on the soft patio seating as the water feature provides a soothing soundtrack. When the sunshine beckons, there’s seating around the pool and a sun shelf—perfect for keeping cool or introducing little ones to the water. At bedtime, guests will find a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom on this level. The second level hosts 4 guest bedrooms—2 of the bedrooms have queen beds and 2 have king beds. There’s also a sleeping nook with a twin-over-twin bunk bed and a TV. The third floor is ideal for young adults or families with a kitchenette, picnic-style dining table, sitting area, TV, and a substantial guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and 2 twin beds. Up the spiral staircase to the fourth level, discover a deck with a high-top table for 4 and enchanting views of the turquoise Gulf. Experience a delightful Seagrove Beach escape at White Azaela. Exploring is easy with 6 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, as well as on-site parking. Scenic 395 Beach Access is a short 4-minute walk down Azalea Street and East County Highway 30A. Book today!
